title: tilia americana f. macrophylla
intro: Tilia americana f. macrophylla, commonly known as Bigleaf American Linden, is a variant of the American Linden tree, characterized by its large leaves and distinctive growth pattern. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and anxiety, as well as improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Tilia americana f. macrophylla include sedative and anti-anxiety effects, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies for stress relief. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
